item.title: When the bombs fell on Caracas | Under the Shadow S2E5
item.description: The United States has painted its January 3 invasion of Venezuela as a surgical operation. But for those on the ground it was a disaster. The US killed more than 100 people. It hit civilian targets and left terror and destruction in its wake. This is episode 5 of Under the Shadow, Season 2.

item.title: Class action granted: Angola prisoners head to trial over slave labor

item.title: Poisoned, exploited, abandoned: East Palestine, OH, three years later
item.description: Opportunistic politicians, sensationalist media outlets, class action attorneys—residents affected by the 2023 Norfolk Southern train derailment and chemical disaster have been exploited by everyone and helped by hardly anyone.
